summary: End-to-end verification of TripInspection.jsx multi-angle walkaround + interior + size/recommendation + integrity + bilingual PDF export. All 6 review-request items PASSED against the live preview with real Gemini (gemini-3.1-pro-preview). One full multi-angle analyze (Front + Interior) and one exterior-only analyze completed successfully. Five real browser PDF downloads captured (EN, AR, EN+AR across two runs).

feature_verification.F1_angle_chips_and_default_state: PASS — Five exterior angle chips present (trip-angle-front/-rear/-left/-right/-roof) + trip-scope-interior. Front aria-pressed=true by default, all others false. Front Before/After dropzones visible (trip-front-before, trip-front-after inputs in DOM). trip-analyze DISABLED initially.
feature_verification.F2_validation_no_selection: PASS — Deselecting Front (no angle, no interior) shows 'Select at least one area to inspect.' and trip-analyze stays disabled.
feature_verification.F3_validation_incomplete_pair: PASS — Re-selecting Front and uploading ONLY front-before shows inline amber hint 'Add both a Before and After photo for Front to include this angle.' and trip-analyze stays disabled.
feature_verification.F4_multi_angle_plus_interior_analyze: PASS — Front + Interior selected, 4 photos uploaded, Analyze enabled. After ~60s trip-result rendered with banner 'New damage detected this trip'. Both trip-section-exterior (labelled 'Exterior — Front') and trip-section-interior present.
feature_verification.F5_coverage_chip: PASS — trip-coverage reads 'Coverage 1/5 + Interior' (interior-only second run showed 'Coverage 1/5' without '+ Interior' suffix as expected).
feature_verification.F6_cost_summary: PASS — trip-cost-summary visible: 'Est. new-damage repair QAR 1,700–7,480' (full run); 'QAR 1,020–4,080' (front-only run).
feature_verification.C_size_and_recommendation: PASS — Findings include size strings ['~120 cm', '~20 cm', '~20 cm', '~35 cm'] and recommendation labels ['Replace','Assess'] (Repair not triggered by these images, but rendering is confirmed). Per-item QAR costs present: ['~QAR 680–2,550', '~QAR 340–1,530', '~QAR 340–1,700', '~QAR 340–1,700'].
feature_verification.E_integrity: PASS — trip-integrity-warning panel rendered (count=1) inside a section and 'Image-integrity warnings' note shown in overall card. Advisory and renders without breaking. (Note: triggered on this image set; expected behavior per request — advisory may or may not fire.)
feature_verification.G_bilingual_pdf_export: PASS — Language dropdown options: [{en,EN},{ar,AR},{bilingual,EN+AR}]. All three selections produced real browser downloads via page.expect_download. Filenames: 'trip-inspection-report-1782764913396.pdf' (EN, 198,781 bytes), 'trip-inspection-report-1782764914380.pdf' (AR, 173,562 bytes), 'trip-inspection-report-1782764915360.pdf' (EN+AR, 235,322 bytes). All prefixes 'trip-inspection-report-'. Zero console/page errors during exports.
feature_verification.console_errors: PASS — 0 console errors and 0 page errors captured across full run including 3 PDF generations.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor (not blocking): exportPdf() handles all three languages including the html2canvas-based Arabic/bilingual path without throwing — confirmed via expect_download and zero pageerror events. File sizes (~170-500 KB) are reasonable.
Minor (not blocking): Front is preselected by default. The 'Select at least one area' guard only fires after the user explicitly deselects Front, which is the right UX. Verified.

Minor: per-angle hidden file inputs share testIds without an '-input' suffix (e.g. trip-front-before is the <input> itself). This matches the request — set_input_files works directly without waiting on visibility. No change needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TripInspection v4 (multi-angle walkaround + interior + size/recommendation + integrity + bilingual PDF) verified end-to-end. Key testids: trip-angle-{front|rear|left|right|roof}, trip-scope-interior, trip-{angle}-before/-after (the input itself, hidden — use set_input_files without wait_for visibility), trip-interior-before/-after, trip-analyze, trip-reset, trip-result, trip-section-exterior/-interior, trip-coverage, trip-cost-summary, trip-integrity-warning, trip-export-lang (option values: 'en','ar','bilingual' — NOT 'EN_AR'), trip-export-pdf. PDF filename prefix: 'trip-inspection-report-'. Wrap each export click in page.expect_download(timeout=60000); wait_for_function to detect button re-enabled before next export. Real Gemini analyze: ~30-60s per pair, parallel; allow up to 220s for multi-pair runs. Images downloaded to /tmp/trip/{ext,int}_{before,after}.png for reuse.
